package verbs_test

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	client "example.com/verbs/gen/http/verbs/client"
	svc "example.com/verbs/gen/verbs"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type methodDoer struct {
	client *http.Client
	calls  atomic.Int32
}

func TestFramingMethods(t *testing.T) {
	for _, h2 := range []bool{false, true} {
		protocol := "http1"
		if h2 {
			protocol = "http2"
		}
		for _, method := range []string{"get", "head", "delete", "options", "post", "put", "patch"} {
			for _, tc := range []struct {
				name, body, want string
				length           *int64
			}{
				{"zero", "", "0", new(int64(0))},
				{"positive", "abc", "3", new(int64(3))},
				{"absent", "abc", "", nil},
			} {
				t.Run(protocol+"/"+method+"/"+tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
					seen := make(chan string, 1)
					host := httptest.NewUnstartedServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
						got, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
						require.NoError(t, err)
						require.Equal(t, tc.body, string(got))
						if h2 {
							require.Equal(t, 2, r.ProtoMajor)
						} else {
							require.Equal(t, 1, r.ProtoMajor)
						}
						seen <- r.Header.Get("Content-Length")
						w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
					}))
					host.EnableHTTP2 = h2
					if h2 {
						host.StartTLS()
					} else {
						host.Start()
					}
					defer host.Close()
					address, err := url.Parse(host.URL)
					require.NoError(t, err)
					transport := &methodDoer{client: host.Client()}
					c := client.NewClient(address.Scheme, address.Host, transport, loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
					body := io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(tc.body))
					var endpoint loom.Endpoint
					var payload any
					switch method {
					case "get":
						endpoint, payload = c.Get(), &svc.GetRequestData{Payload: &svc.GetPayload{Length: tc.length}, Body: body}
					case "head":
						endpoint, payload = c.Head(), &svc.HeadRequestData{Payload: &svc.HeadPayload{Length: tc.length}, Body: body}
					case "delete":
						endpoint, payload = c.Delete(), &svc.DeleteRequestData{Payload: &svc.DeletePayload{Length: tc.length}, Body: body}
					case "options":
						endpoint, payload = c.Options(), &svc.OptionsRequestData{Payload: &svc.OptionsPayload{Length: tc.length}, Body: body}
					case "post":
						endpoint, payload = c.Post(), &svc.PostRequestData{Payload: &svc.PostPayload{Length: tc.length}, Body: body}
					case "put":
						endpoint, payload = c.Put(), &svc.PutRequestData{Payload: &svc.PutPayload{Length: tc.length}, Body: body}
					case "patch":
						endpoint, payload = c.Patch(), &svc.PatchRequestData{Payload: &svc.PatchPayload{Length: tc.length}, Body: body}
					}
					_, err = endpoint(context.Background(), payload)
					if tc.name == "zero" && method != "post" && method != "put" && method != "patch" {
						require.ErrorContains(t, err, "explicit Content-Length 0 cannot be sent")
						require.Zero(t, transport.calls.Load())
						select {
						case value := <-seen:
							t.Errorf("rejected zero reached server with length %q", value)
						default:
						}
					} else {
						require.NoError(t, err)
						require.EqualValues(t, 1, transport.calls.Load())
						require.Equal(t, tc.want, <-seen)
					}
				})
			}
		}
	}
}

func (d *methodDoer) Do(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	d.calls.Add(1)
	return d.client.Do(req)
}
